negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, CGI, 3D video game render, Unreal Engine asset, digital illustration, modern cars, neon signs, asphalt road, modern concrete skyscrapers, daytime sunlight, flat lighting, oversaturated cartoon style
reconstruction_priority: practical lighting physics — AI often paints glowing CGI bloom or flat illumination instead of the realistic physical light falloff from the miniature streetlamp and window panes
tactile diorama craftsmanship — AI frequently replaces weathered plaster, stone quoins, and carved wood with smooth sterile digital planes
complementary color grading — AI tends to homogenize the palette into a single muddy blue or brown rather than maintaining the rich contrast between 2800K amber and 8000K twilight slate
detailed miniature props — AI often distorts the structure of the miniature armchair, streetlamp curvature, or cobblestone pattern
